items.title: LangGraph Vulnerability Allows Malicious Python Code Execution During Deserialization
items.description: A critical remote code execution vulnerability has been discovered in LangGraph’s checkpoint serialization system. The flaw CVE-2025-64439 affects versions of langgraph-checkpoint before 3.0. It allows attackers to execute arbitrary Python code when untrusted data is deserialized. The vulnerability resides in LangGraph’s JsonPlusSerializer, the default serialization protocol used for checkpoint…
